thread:
Maria Chen: Heads up — I'd like to onboard vireo-7b-int8 as a lower-cost variant for convo+summarization experiments. planning to run quantized smoke + canary across hosted and Dedicated. thoughts?
Raj Patel: need eval deck + perf numbers before canary. can you attach eval set + baseline metrics?
Maria Chen: attached perf snapshot in drive (link) — baseline is baseline-7b-fp16. quick TL;DR: ~1.9x token throughput improvement in int8 local bench, memory down ~30%, but small quality differences on summarization tests.
Elena Garcia: saw a 2.1% drop on XSUM rouge-1 vs fp16 in our 1k eval sample (mean). convo quality (perplexity) is similar. quant config was symmetric per-layer int8.
Tom S: routing notes — suggest canary split: hosted 5% -> 15% over 24h; Dedicated 10% -> 30% after smoke. Private deployments left to customer opt-in. fallback route -> baseline-7b-fp16, auto-roll back if gating fails.
Jason K: important: KV cache growth with int8 kernels looked ~10% larger in our bench due to padding behavior. need bench for typical chat seq lengths (avg 512). if cache blowup occurs we should limit max history on canary.
Maria Chen: proposed smoke tests and gating:
```
smoke_tests: [api-stream, short-gen-sanity, summarize-1k]
canary_schedule:
  hosted: [5% for 6h, 15% for 18h]
  dedicated: [10% for 8h, 30% for 16h]
metrics_gates:
  - rouge1_drop_threshold: 1.5%  # fail if >1.5 drop vs baseline
  - p50_latency_ms: 200
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
fallback: baseline-7b-fp16
```
Maria Chen: I'll own smoke triage and the eval rerun. @Raj can you run the full XSUM/AMT slices and push per-window diffs by EOD?
Raj Patel: on it. will run 10k XSUM/64-shot convo slice with exact prompt templates. will include token-usage delta.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: vireo-7b-int8 @ canary-hosted-5pct -> started 2471504380
qa-bot: smoke probe results (first hour): convo latency p50=185ms, p95=310ms, rouge1 delta = -1.8% on XSUM sample (n=1k), error_rate=0.12%
Elena Garcia: rouge1 -1.8% is slightly above our 1.5% gate. need narrow investigation: maybe quant noise on cross-attention layers. recommend try per-layer mixed precision for cross-attn or apply per-channel calibration.
Tom S: operationally: hold canary at 5% hosted until we validate fix. set autoscaler min for canary to 2 instances to avoid noisy cold starts. add circuit-breaker to route >0.5% errors to baseline.
Jason K: config to update routing policy quickly:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/routing/update -d '{"model":"vireo-7b-int8","canary":{"hosted":5},"fallback":"baseline-7b-fp16"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
Oncall: noted. also add SLO alert: fire if p95 latency increases >30% from baseline or error_rate >0.5% for 5m. paging policy -> @Oncall if triggered.
Maria Chen: action items:
- Raj: full eval slices + token delta (owner)
- Elena: try mixed-precision cross-attn quick patch, re-run 1k XSUM (owner)
- Tom: gate config + autoscaler min (owner)
- Jason: ready rollback command + routing patch (owner)
- Maria: monitor smoke, coordinate deploy-bot triggers, post canary summary in #eng-ml by EOD (owner)

Maria Chen: leaning toward delaying expansion until rouge1 delta <=1.5%. if we can get to ~1% via mixed precision we're good to proceed to 15% hosted.
Elena Garcia: quick note — also run hallucination check on summarization (precision of facts). small rouge improvements may not reflect factuality.
Raj Patel: will add hallucination checklist to the eval run.
Tom S: final ask — document expected cost delta per 1M tokens on console and add to canary dashboard tile. ops needs that to approve Dedicated shift.
Maria Chen: +1. will add cost sheet. tagging follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
Jason K: adding runbook snippet to the thread for rapid rollback:
```
# rollback
rdctl routes set --model baseline-7b-fp16 --weight 100 --env hosted
rdctl scale set --model vireo-7b-int8 --replicas 0 --env hosted
```
Maria Chen: thanks all — let's reconvene after Raj/Elena's runs.
